response.overview: Winter and Seohyun, college students who rely on AI for their daily lives. Through a random blind date booth at the festival site, "Seohyun" meets "Winter" and uses AI to show off her fantastic tiki-taka until the actual meeting, but when they meet offline, they cannot talk. "Winter" will eventually be caught talking to "Seohyun" using AI, but "Seohyun" will see the truth of "Winter" and the two will fall in more sincere love.
response.title: GPT
